u319f.content:
Residential
No-cost Home Energy Assessment (HEA) 
Rather than focusing on a single problem like an old heating and water system, not enough insulation in the attic, or leaky windows, a no-cost Home Energy Assessment looks for opportunities throughout an entire home to improve performance. 
Manufactured Homes Initiative (MHI)
Residential customers in manufactured homes with active SEMCO natural gas accounts may be eligible for no-cost upgrades. These upgrades are designed to increase a home’s comfort and reduce overall energy costs.
Multifamily Energy Efficiency Program
SEMCO’s Multifamily Energy Efficiency Program offers reduced-cost energy-efficient upgrades for multifamily properties. This program also offers no-cost direct installation of showerheads, faucet aerators, and pipe wrap, based on water heater fuel type. 
Energy Efficiency Assistance Program
The SEMCO Energy Efficiency Assistance Program reduces financial barriers to energy efficiency and home comfort by providing customers with increased incentives for EWR upgrades. Participants must be SEMCO residential customers and meet the household income levels established (currently 200 percent of poverty level), which is based on the federal income guidelines published by the US Department of Energy Weatherization Program. Renters must have expressed consent from property owner to qualify for upgrades.

u3698.content:
New construction rebates
Energy efficiency Home Energy Rating System (HERS) rated homes with a score of 56 or lower can receive a rebate for building energy efficient. Go to www.hersindex.com to learn more about HERS ratings
Energy efficiency rebates
SEMCO’s EWR program offers generous rebates to help encourage customers to make the most energy-efficient choice. Rebates are only available to SEMCO customers and are subject to change. For specific eligibility requirements,  visit semcoewr.com. We offer rebates in the following areas:
Space heatingWater heatingAir sealing and insulationWindow and door replacementsENERGY STAR
Our Marketplace
Our online store makes it easier than ever to save on the latest smart thermostats from ecobee and Google Nest. Customers can save up to $100 instantly on Wi-Fi enabled thermostats, with no need to complete a rebate application. We ship the  new thermostat directly to their home within two weeks.
